name: ACP (Agentic Commerce)
summary: The Agentic Commerce Protocol is an open standard for checkout flows between buyers, their AI agents and businesses. It defines a Checkout API and a Delegated Payment spec so an agent can complete a purchase while the merchant stays the merchant of record. Stripe and OpenAI maintain it, and ChatGPT was the first platform to implement it.
goodFor: Agent checkout without sharing raw card details
watchOut: Still beta with frequent dated spec versions
Competes with the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), which Stripe also supports
Shares the ACP acronym with the Agent Client Protocol
